title: Python Programming for AI & Enterprise
tagline: From Pythonic fundamentals to production AI services, data pipelines and agents

units.topics: Python 3 runtime and interpreters; variables, data types and operators; control flow; functions, arguments and scope; strings, lists, tuples, sets and dictionaries; comprehensions; files and context managers; exceptions; modules and packages; virtual environments and the uv/pip toolchain; Jupyter and VS Code workflows.
units.out: Builds a command-line expense tracker with file storage, input validation and error handling, packaged as a module.

units.topics: Classes, inheritance, composition, dunder methods and dataclasses; protocols and abstract base classes; iterators, generators and decorators; functional tools (map, filter, functools, itertools); type hints, generics and static checking (mypy/pyright); unit testing with pytest, fixtures and mocking; code quality with Ruff.
units.out: Delivers a typed library-management package with dataclasses, decorators, 90% pytest coverage and a clean Ruff/mypy report.

units.topics: NumPy arrays and vectorisation; pandas and Polars for data wrangling; visualisation with Matplotlib and Plotly; SQL access with SQLAlchemy and DuckDB; concurrency models: threads, the GIL and free-threaded Python, multiprocessing, asyncio; profiling with cProfile and memory tools.
units.out: Produces a sales-analytics pipeline in Polars + DuckDB with charts, and an asyncio web scraper benchmarked against a threaded version.

units.t: Web APIs and AI Engineering with Python
units.topics: HTTP and REST; FastAPI routing, dependency injection and async endpoints; Pydantic data validation; authentication (OAuth2, JWT); background tasks and queues (Celery, Redis); calling ML models and LLM APIs; structured outputs and tool calling; building retrieval-augmented and agent applications; MCP servers in Python.
units.out: Ships a FastAPI service with JWT auth that serves an ML model and an LLM-powered assistant using tool calls and a Python MCP server.

units.t: Production Python: Performance, Packaging and Security
units.topics: Project layout and pyproject.toml; packaging and publishing wheels; dependency locking; performance: vectorisation, Numba, Cython and Rust extensions via PyO3; logging and observability; Docker images for Python; CI/CD with GitHub Actions; security: secrets, dependency scanning (pip-audit), SBOMs and secure coding.
units.out: Publishes a versioned package to a private index with a Rust-accelerated hot path, Docker image, CI pipeline and a clean pip-audit report.

capstone: AI-Powered Business Insights Service: a FastAPI platform that ingests company data with Polars, serves forecasts from an ML model, answers questions through an LLM agent with tool calls, and ships as a tested, containerised, security-scanned package with CI/CD.

certs.name: PCEP – Certified Entry-Level Python Programmer
PCAP – Certified Associate Python Programmer
PCPP1 / PCPP2 – Certified Professional Python Programmer
Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark (Python)
NPTEL/SWAYAM: The Joy of Computing using Python

outlook.t: First choice for model building, LLM applications, agents and evaluation; expected to remain the language of AI.
Core language for data pipelines, notebooks and analytics, alongside SQL.
Scripting, testing, infrastructure automation and AI-driven operations.
Free-threaded Python and Rust extensions (PyO3) close the speed gap for production workloads.

cos.txt: Explain Python's data model, runtime and idiomatic constructs.
Apply object-oriented, functional and typed programming with automated tests.
Analyse data and choose the right concurrency model for a workload.
Build secure web APIs and AI/LLM applications in Python.
Create a packaged, optimised, secure and deployable Python product.

title: Go Programming for Cloud-Native Systems
tagline: Simple, fast, concurrent services for cloud platforms, DevOps and AI infrastructure

units.topics: Go philosophy and toolchain (go build, run, fmt, vet); packages and modules; variables, constants and basic types; control flow; functions, multiple returns and closures; arrays, slices and maps; strings, runes and UTF-8; pointers; explicit error values and wrapping.
units.out: Builds a log-file analyser CLI that parses large files with slices and maps and reports errors with wrapping.

units.topics: Structs, methods and embedding; interfaces and implicit satisfaction; type switches; generics with type parameters and constraints; package design and visibility; table-driven unit tests, benchmarks and fuzzing; examples and documentation; dependency management with Go modules.
units.out: Delivers a generic, interface-based inventory library with table-driven tests, fuzz tests and benchmarks.

units.topics: Goroutines and the Go scheduler; channels (buffered, unbuffered) and select; worker pools, pipelines and fan-in/fan-out; context for cancellation and deadlines; sync.Mutex, WaitGroup, Once and atomics; errgroup; race detection; common concurrency bugs and how to avoid them.
units.out: Builds a concurrent web crawler with a worker pool, rate limiting and context cancellation that passes the race detector.

units.topics: net/http servers, routing and middleware; JSON APIs; gRPC and Protocol Buffers; database access with database/sql and pgx; configuration and graceful shutdown; authentication; structured logging (slog); metrics and tracing with OpenTelemetry and Prometheus.
units.out: Ships a REST + gRPC order microservice on PostgreSQL with middleware, graceful shutdown and Prometheus metrics.

units.topics: Container-friendly Go builds (static binaries, distroless images); Kubernetes client-go and operators; CLI tools with Cobra; profiling with pprof and performance tuning; security (govulncheck, secrets, TLS); Go for AI infrastructure: LLM gateways, vector-search services and MCP servers.
units.out: Deploys a Kubernetes operator and an LLM API gateway in Go with caching, rate limits, pprof profiling and a clean govulncheck scan.

capstone: Cloud-Native AI Gateway Platform: a Go platform that routes, caches and rate-limits requests to several LLM providers, exposes REST and gRPC APIs, runs on Kubernetes with an operator for configuration, and provides full metrics and tracing.

certs.name: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
Google Cloud Professional Cloud Developer
HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
GitHub portfolio assessment (no official Go language exam exists)

outlook.t: Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform and much of the cloud-native ecosystem are written in Go; expected to stay central.
Fast, low-memory services with simple deployment as single binaries.
Gateways, agent hosting, vector-search services and MCP servers that must be reliable at scale.
CLIs, automation and observability tooling.

cos.txt: Explain Go's design, types, slices, maps and error model.
Apply interfaces, generics and testing to build reusable packages.
Analyse and build correct concurrent programs with goroutines and channels.
Build observable HTTP and gRPC microservices with persistent storage.
Create cloud-native Go tools and AI infrastructure services for Kubernetes.

title: Rust Programming for Safe Systems
tagline: Memory-safe, high-performance software for systems, security, edge and AI infrastructure
prereq: C or any compiled language, data structures

units.topics: Why Rust: memory safety, performance and security; rustup, Cargo and crates.io; variables, mutability and data types; functions and control flow; ownership, moves and copies; references and borrowing; slices; the stack and the heap; reading compiler errors as guidance.
units.out: Builds a text-statistics CLI with Cargo that processes files using borrowed slices and passes Clippy with no warnings.

units.topics: Structs and methods; enums and pattern matching; Option and Result; error handling with ?, thiserror and anyhow; traits, trait objects and generics; lifetimes in functions and structs; modules, crates and workspaces; unit, integration and documentation tests.
units.out: Delivers a bank-ledger library modelled with enums and traits, typed errors and full unit and integration tests.

units.topics: Vec, String, HashMap and BTreeMap; iterators and closures; iterator adapters for zero-cost data processing; Box, Rc, Arc, RefCell and interior mutability; Deref and Drop; macros (declarative); performance measurement with Criterion; idiomatic API design.
units.out: Builds a fast CSV analytics engine with iterator chains and smart pointers, benchmarked with Criterion against a Python version.

units.topics: Threads, message passing and shared state with Mutex and Arc; Send and Sync; Rayon for data parallelism; async/await and the Tokio runtime; async I/O and networking; unsafe Rust and its rules; FFI with C; Python extensions with PyO3 and maturin.
units.out: Ships a Tokio-based concurrent TCP chat server and a PyO3 extension that speeds up a Python hot loop.

units.t: Production Rust: Web, WebAssembly, Embedded and AI
units.topics: Web services with Axum and SQLx; WebAssembly with wasm-bindgen; embedded Rust (embedded-hal, Embassy) on microcontrollers; AI and ML in Rust (Candle, Burn, ONNX Runtime bindings); observability with tracing; supply-chain security (cargo-audit, cargo-deny); Rust in the Linux kernel and safety-critical industries.
units.out: Deploys an Axum REST service with SQLx, a WebAssembly front-end module and an on-device inference demo, with a clean cargo-audit report.

capstone: Secure High-Performance Inference Service: a Rust platform with an Axum API, Tokio-based request batching, an ONNX/Candle model runtime, a PyO3 module for data scientists and a WebAssembly client, delivered with fuzz tests and supply-chain checks.

certs.name: LFEL1002: Getting Started with Rust (exam-based badge)
LFD480: Programming in Rust (course certificate and badge)
Courses from Rust Foundation Trusted Training providers
Ardan Labs Rust certification (vendor exam)

outlook.t: Security guidance increasingly favours memory-safe languages for new critical code; Rust is the leading choice.
Tokenisers, inference engines, data engines (Polars) and vector databases.
Safe firmware and safety-critical components.
Browser, serverless and smart-contract platforms.

cos.txt: Explain ownership, borrowing and lifetimes and why they guarantee memory safety.
Apply enums, traits, generics and error handling to model real problems.
Analyse performance and write efficient code with iterators and smart pointers.
Build safe concurrent, async and cross-language (FFI, PyO3) components.
Create production Rust services for web, WebAssembly, embedded or AI targets.

title: Scala Programming for Big Data & Functional Systems
tagline: Functional programming on the JVM for data platforms, streaming and reliable distributed services

units.topics: Scala and the JVM; sbt and scala-cli; expressions, values and types; methods and functions; classes, objects and traits; case classes and companion objects; Scala 3 syntax (indentation, enums, extension methods); string interpolation; interoperability with Java libraries.
units.out: Builds a student-records application with case classes, enums and traits, using a Java library from Scala.

units.topics: Immutability and pure functions; higher-order functions and currying; algebraic data types and pattern matching; Option, Either and Try for safe error handling; recursion and tail calls; type classes with givens and using clauses; for-comprehensions; property-based testing with ScalaCheck.
units.out: Delivers a pure-functional order-validation module with ADTs, Either-based errors and ScalaCheck property tests.

units.topics: Immutable and mutable collections; lazy views; Futures and Promises; effect systems: Cats Effect IO and ZIO; resource safety, fibers and structured concurrency; streaming with fs2 / ZIO Streams; the actor model with Apache Pekko (Akka fork).
units.out: Builds a concurrent file-processing pipeline in Cats Effect with fs2 streaming and safe resource handling.

units.topics: Spark architecture (driver, executors, DAG); RDDs, DataFrames and Datasets in Scala; Spark SQL and Catalyst optimiser; partitioning, joins and performance tuning; Delta Lake / Iceberg tables; Spark Structured Streaming with Kafka; Spark MLlib pipelines.
units.out: Ships a Spark-Scala lakehouse job that processes millions of transactions, plus a Structured Streaming fraud-alert pipeline from Kafka.

units.t: Production Scala: Services, Streaming and Data Platforms
units.topics: HTTP services with http4s, ZIO HTTP or Play; JSON with Circe; database access with Doobie/Skunk; Kafka producers and consumers; Apache Flink stream processing concepts; testing (MUnit, ScalaTest, Testcontainers); packaging, Docker and deployment; observability and JVM tuning.
units.out: Deploys a containerised http4s service on Kafka and PostgreSQL with full tests and a Spark job orchestrated on a schedule.

capstone: Real-Time Financial Data Platform: Kafka ingestion, Spark Structured Streaming for fraud detection, Delta Lake storage, and a functional http4s API serving risk scores, built with typed, tested Scala and deployed in containers.

certs.name: Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark

outlook.t: Spark, Kafka-based systems and many data platforms are built on the JVM; Scala skills help with core engine work.
Type-safe, functional code for real-time, high-reliability financial systems.
Its ideas (immutability, ADTs, effects) shape modern Java, Kotlin, Rust and TypeScript.
Large-scale feature pipelines and data preparation for AI products.

cos.txt: Explain Scala 3's type system, syntax and JVM interoperability.
Apply functional programming to model domains safely.
Build concurrent, resource-safe programs with effect systems and actors.
Analyse and optimise large-scale Spark batch and streaming jobs.
Create production Scala data platforms and services.

title: Java Programming for Enterprise & AI Applications
tagline: Modern Java, Spring Boot microservices and AI-enabled enterprise systems

units.topics: JDK, JVM and JRE; compilation and bytecode; data types, operators and control flow; arrays and strings; classes, objects, constructors, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism and abstraction; interfaces; packages and the module system; exception handling; build tools (Maven, Gradle).
units.out: Builds a console banking system with full OOP design, custom exceptions and a Maven build.

units.t: Modern Java: Generics, Collections, Lambdas and Streams
units.topics: Generics and bounded types; the Collections Framework (List, Set, Map, Queue); equals, hashCode and Comparable; lambdas, functional interfaces and method references; Stream API and collectors; Optional; records, sealed classes and pattern matching for switch; text blocks; unit testing with JUnit 5 and Mockito.
units.out: Delivers an employee-analytics module using records, sealed types and the Stream API, with JUnit 5 tests.

units.topics: Threads, executors and CompletableFuture; virtual threads (Project Loom) and structured concurrency; synchronisation, locks and concurrent collections; memory model; JVM internals: class loading, JIT, garbage collectors (G1, ZGC); profiling with JDK Flight Recorder; I/O and NIO.
units.out: Builds a high-throughput order processor comparing platform and virtual threads, profiled with JFR and tuned GC.

units.topics: Dependency injection and Spring Core; Spring Boot 3; REST APIs with Spring Web; validation; data access with Spring Data JPA and Hibernate; transactions; Spring Security with OAuth2/JWT; testing with Spring Boot Test and Testcontainers; API documentation (OpenAPI).
units.out: Ships a secured Spring Boot e-commerce API with JPA, PostgreSQL, OAuth2/JWT and Testcontainers integration tests.

units.topics: Microservices patterns; messaging with Apache Kafka; caching with Redis; observability with Micrometer and OpenTelemetry; Docker, Kubernetes and GraalVM native images; AI in Java: Spring AI and LangChain4j for LLM calls, RAG and tool use; security and dependency scanning (OWASP Dependency-Check).
units.out: Deploys Kafka-connected Spring Boot microservices on Kubernetes with a GraalVM native image and a Spring AI RAG assistant.

capstone: AI-Enabled Enterprise Commerce Platform: Spring Boot microservices for catalogue, orders and payments connected by Kafka, secured with OAuth2, deployed on Kubernetes with native images, and a Spring AI assistant that answers customer and staff questions from company data.
